title: Prepare bounded repair evidence after evaluation
command: Read {plugin_dir}/SKILL.md. After the existing pipeline admits and completes evaluation, prepare the img2.repair-observation artifact and bind its reference, spec, source, render profile, evaluation and pipeline-state files. Use the prepare command documented in the skill. Do not append the repair action until the advisory recommendation has been inspected. In shadow mode preserve the baseline decision.

title: Inspect advice without changing pipeline authority
command: Read the img2.repair-recommendation artifact under the workspace .img2/artifacts/jev directory. A shadow recommendation never changes the baseline; assist proposals require approval. Recheck the current pipeline gates and correction limits before recording its canonical action. Never treat the Jev artifact-integrity gate as visual, geometry or final acceptance.
